text: PyAirbyte lets Python and AI developers use Airbyte programmatically as a library
quote: PyAirbyte brings the power of Airbyte to every Python and AI developer.

text: Airbyte configuration can be managed as code via an official Terraform provider
quote: you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code

text: A documented API lets you control Airbyte programmatically, e.g. from orchestrators like Airflow
quote: Use the Airbyte API to programmatically interact with Airbyte. For example, you can control Airbyte in conjunction with orchestration tools like Airflow.

text: A no-code Connector Builder in the UI lets you develop custom connectors without leaving Airbyte
quote: Connector Builder is a no-code tool that’s part of the Airbyte UI... letting you develop a connector to use in data syncs without ever needing to leave your Airbyte workspace.

text: An AI Assistant can auto-prefill fields in the Connector Builder to speed up connector setup
quote: AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder, drastically reducing setup time.

text: MCP-capable agents (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex) can connect to your data through Airbyte Agents
quote: Connect MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex to your data through Airbyte Agents.

text: Sync modes define the combined behavior of how a source is read and a destination is written
quote: A sync mode is a combination of a source and destination mode together.

text: Each connection offers a choice of options for how/when a sync is triggered to run
quote: For each connection, you can select between three options that allow a sync to run.

text: Airbyte can send sync notifications to an email address or a webhook
quote: Airbyte can send notifications to an email address, webhook, or both.

text: A Connection Timeline shows historical events and activity for a connection
quote: The Connection Timeline displays historical information about relevant connection events.

text: dbt Cloud integration runs dbt transformations automatically right after Airbyte Cloud syncs complete
quote: By using the dbt Cloud integration, you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.

text: A quickstart lets you deploy a local instance of open-source Airbyte Core in minutes
quote: This quickstart guides you through deploying a local instance of Airbyte Core, Airbyte's open source product. Setup only takes a few minutes, and you can start moving data immediately.

text: abctl CLI makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is available
quote: abctl makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is running.

text: Per-connection settings let you choose how Airbyte handles source schema changes
quote: You can specify for each connection how Airbyte should handle any change of schema in the source.

text: Airbyte can consume database log files to capture INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE changes for replication (CDC)
quote: A consumer of these log files (such as Airbyte) can read these logs while keeping track of the current position within the logs in order to read all record changes coming from DELETE/INSERT/UPDATE statements.

text: Programmatic access to Airbyte generally requires an access token
quote: Most programmatic interactions with Airbyte require an access token.

text: Incremental sync mode pulls only data changed since the previous sync
quote: An incremental sync is a sync which pulls only the data that has changed since the previous sync

text: Data lands with one-to-one stream-to-table mapping, avoiding sub-tables in the warehouse
quote: One-to-one table mapping: Data in one stream will always be mapped to one table in your data warehouse. No more sub-tables.

text: An installation guide covers deploying Airbyte into any Kubernetes cluster
quote: This installation guide walks through how to deploy Airbyte into any kubernetes cluster.

text: Airbyte supports multiple workspaces with SSO and RBAC
quote:
Multiple Workspaces

SSO, RBAC

text: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ maintained connectors for APIs, databases, warehouses, and lakes
quote: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes
